description: This file initializes and renders the React application by mounting the root component 'App' into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports necessary modules including React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree within the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
